attempts.response:
WITH matched AS (
    SELECT 
        a.Applicant,
        a.Course,
        a.Status,
        a.Marks,
        o."School Name" AS School,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.Applicant ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) DESC) AS rn
    FROM "lpf_applications" a
    LEFT JOIN "lpf_outreach" o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS application_count,
    "School Name"
FROM matched
GROUP BY "School Name"
ORDER BY "School Name";
